grade_reason: No statement by John Cowan about AI, of any kind, was found from 1 January 2025 onward. He has never held public office, so there are no official records to check.
notes: Six web searches ran; none was refused. No house.gov site exists (representative-elect). The campaign site cowanforcongress.com (home page and issues.html) was opened: its issues are healthcare, economy, elections, freedoms and government, with no mention of AI, technology or China; the page does not state a year or district, so it may be from his 2020 run. drjohncowan.com is a 'Coming Soon' placeholder. Atlanta News First's 4 November 2026 election article and the Almanac of American Politics preview (rest behind a paywall) contain no Cowan words on AI. Ballotpedia returned an empty page and Becker's Spine returned 403, so neither was read. Not a statement but worth a reviewer's attention: the Transformer AI campaign finance tracker (https://elections.transformernews.ai/races/ga-h-11, citing FEC filings) lists $758,576 from Defending Our Values PAC, labelled 'Pro-safety', supporting Cowan across the primary, runoff and general election. This says nothing about his own views and was not used for grading. He did not sign the House letters (representative-elect) and, as a non-member, could not have co-sponsored the Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act; no source links him to it.
